blocks.text: SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–Coach Tim Cone doesn’t see the reason to understate the impact Jordan Murphy has had for Barangay Ginebra. “You can’t discount what this guy next to me has done for us,” Cone said after Murphy’s near triple-double in the Gin Kings’ 126-99 rout of the San Miguel Beermen in Game 2 of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Murphy had 33 points, 10 rebounds and nine assists as the Gin Kings moved on the cusp of a semifinal berth after staring at the brink of elimination late in the group […]...
